spells.notes: 전두환-era minister still in office on 1988-02-25 (caretaker holdover for part of one day). Named in the 8·26 개각 of 1986 while 전 보건사회부차관 (announced and reported as 임명 on 1986-08-26, 동아일보 1986-08-26), with the 임명장 on the morning of 1986-08-27 and the 이·취임식 at the ministry at 11:00 the same day (경향신문 1986-08-27 p.2). Start follows the 임명장 day, as the culture, foreign and unification ext88 files do for the same reshuffle, hence medium. ko.wikipedia also gives 1986-08-27. The whole 5공 cabinet handed in blanket resignations after the last 국무회의 on 1988-02-24, and the new President accepted them on the morning of 1988-02-25 before giving 최명헌 and the other new ministers their 임명장 the same morning. The spell therefore ends on 1988-02-25 (same-day handover rule used in all ext88 files). The 고용노동부 list prints years only (1986 ~ 1988년) and ko.wikipedia ends him on 1988-02-24. Start follows the 임명장 day, as the environment, general_affairs and unification ext88 files do for the same reshuffle, hence medium. ko.wikipedia starts him on 1992-06-25. Earlier 총무처장관 1990-03-19..1991-12-20 (general_affairs lineage). 노태우's term ended at midnight on 1993-02-24, but ministers had no fixed term and stayed until the new President appointed successors (매일경제 1993-02-24 p.2, 세계일보 1993-02-25). He was therefore in office under 김영삼 on 1993-02-25 and until 이인제 was appointed on 1993-02-26. No report of his own 이임식 was found, so the end is the successor's appointment day. ko.wikipedia ends him on 1993-02-25. Profile age in 조선일보 1992-06-26 ('56세') agrees with the birth year below. birth_date from ko.wikipedia '이연택' https://ko.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=41473291 (tier 4, secondary, accessed 2026-09-26T09:27:40-0400; snapshot roster/sources/labor/ext88/bios/wiki_이연택.json). VERIFIER: end disputed, value kept at 1993-02-26. 중앙일보 1993-02-25 (BigKinds 01100901.19930225151908002) reports that the outgoing cabinet's resignations were submitted and all accepted on 1993-02-25, which would end the spell on 1993-02-25. Against it, 조선일보 1993-02-24 p.3 reports the government view that the 6공 ministers serve until successors are formally appointed, and 동아일보 1993-02-26 p.3 and 서울신문 1993-02-27 report outgoing ministers of other ministries holding their 이임식 on the morning of 1993-02-26. No labor-specific exit report was found (News Library and BigKinds searches for 이연택 1993-02-20..03-02). No tier-1 record settles the date. The education, energy and general_affairs verifiers marked the same 1993 question disputed.

spells.notes: Named on the morning of 1995-05-24 to fill the post left vacant by 이형구's resignation. He was in Taiwan, flew back that afternoon and received his 임명장 at 09:00 on 1995-05-25 (조선일보 1995-05-25, 매일경제 1995-05-26). Start follows the 임명장 day, which leaves 1995-05-24 as a one-day vacancy (see acting and issues). The 대통령기록관 schedule, the 대한민국사연표 and ko.wikipedia date the appointment 1995-05-24, the day he was named. Earlier 동력자원부장관 (energy lineage). issues.desc: Vacancy on 1995-05-24 depends on the start-date convention. 이형구's resignation was accepted on the afternoon of 1995-05-23. 진념 was named on the morning of 1995-05-24 and got his 임명장 at 09:00 on 1995-05-25. This file starts 진념 on the 임명장 day, as every ext88 lineage does, which leaves 1995-05-24 vacant with 차관 최승부 as inferred acting head. The 대통령기록관 schedule ('신임 진념 노동부장관 임명', 1995-05-24), the 대한민국사연표 (tcct_1995_05_24_0010), ko.wikipedia and the day-after press ('24일 ... 임명했다') date the appointment 1995-05-24. If a 관보 or other record shows 1995-05-24 as the legal appointment date, 진념's start moves to 1995-05-24, the vacancy disappears and the acting record should be dropped.

Announcement day against 임명장 day. In five labor appointments the appointment was announced on one day and the 임명장 given on the next. The cases are 이헌기 (1986-08-26/27), 이연택 (1992-06-25/26), 남재희 (1993-12-21/22), 이형구 (1994-12-23/24) and 진념 (1995-05-24/25), plus the main file's 이기호 (1997-08-05/06). Starts follow the 임명장 day and are marked medium. The outgoing ministers' ends follow the same day (최병렬, 이인제, 남재희, 진념 are inferred_from_successor because no 이임식 report was found). nomination_date is the announcement day and outcome_date the 임명장 day. No 관보 file exists before 2001, and the 고용노동부 list prints years only, so no tier 1 date is available.

Transitions of 1988-02-25 and 1993-02-25. 이헌기 (appointed by 전두환) held office on 1988-02-25 until the 5공 cabinet's blanket resignation was accepted that morning, the same morning 최명헌 was appointed, so he has one day in the window and ends 1988-02-25, like the other ext88 holdovers. 이연택 (appointed by 노태우) stayed in office under 김영삼 on 1993-02-25 and until 이인제 was appointed on 1993-02-26 (ministers had no fixed term, 매일경제 1993-02-24 and 세계일보 1993-02-25). Three other ext88 lineages (education, foreign, general_affairs) end some 노태우-era ministers on 1993-02-25 instead of 1993-02-26. The builder should use one convention.

Member-ministers. 최명헌 sat in the 12th Assembly until 1988-05-29 while minister, 장영철 in the 13th and 이인제 in the 14th for their whole spells, and 최병렬 in the 14th from 1992-05-30 until he was replaced on 1992-06-26. Seat dates are from na_members/na_members_12_22.csv. The dual-office review for 1988-1998 should pick these up.

ko.wikipedia '대한민국 고용노동부 장관' (oldid 42117776) was used only as a secondary check. It differs from this file on 이헌기 end (1988-02-24), 최병렬 end and 이연택 start (1992-06-25), 이연택 end (1993-02-25), 이인제 end (1993-12-21), 남재희 end (1994-12-23), 이형구 end (1995-05-24), 진념 start (1995-05-24) and end (1997-08-05), and 이기호 end (1999-05-25). In each case the page uses the announcement day or the day before the successor's start.
